resources.string: Faka umhla weHijri ukuze ufumane iArafah, An-Nahr kunye neentsuku zeTashreeq
Faka umhla weHijri ukuze ubone iArafah, An-Nahr kunye neentsuku zeTashreeq
Faka umhla weHijri osebenzayo. Unyaka ukusuka kwi-1300 ukuya kwi-1600, inyanga ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-12, usuku ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-30.

Faka nawuphi na umhla weHijri (okanye ugcine umhla wangoku) ukuze ufumane ngoko nangoko iintsuku zeHajj zonyaka wayo: uMhla we-Arafah (9 Dhul-Hijjah), uMhla we-An-Nahr (10 Dhul-Hijjah) kunye neeNtsuku zeTashreeq (11, 12 kunye ne-13 Dhul-Hijjah), nganye ihambelana nomhla wayo weGregolent.
Eyona ntsika inkulu: yima eArafah ukusuka emva kwemini kude kube kutshona ilanga, usenza izibongozo ezininzi, i-takbir kunye ne-tahlil. Wathi uMprofeti (SAW): "IHajj yiArafah."
I-Eid al-Adha: ilitye i-Jamarat al-Aqabah ngeengqalutye ezisixhenxe, yenza idini, uchebe okanye uchebe, emva koko wenze i-Tawaf al-Ifadah kunye neSai.
Isaziso semihla ngemihla esikukhumbuza ngesithethe esicetywayo ngexesha laso ngeentsuku zeHajj (8-13 Dhul-Hijjah)

I-sunnah yale mini: faka ihram, uye eMina kwaye uchithe ubusuku apho, uphinda iTalbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", kwaye uthandaze apho ufutshane ngaphandle kokudibanisa.
Yitye iJamarat emithathu emva kwemini: incinci, ibephakathi, ize enkulu, iingqalutye ezisixhenxe lisithi takbir, libongoza emva kwezincinci neziphakathi.

Phinda uxulube iiJamarat ezintathu emva kwemini njengayizolo. Nabani na onqwenela ukungxama angahamba eMina lingekatshoni ilanga; nabani na olalayo uchitha ubusuku aze axulube ngamatye ngomhla wesithathu.
Jikele iJamarat ezintathu emva kwemini, uze ugqibezele iHajj ngeTawaf yokuvalelisa xa ushiya iMakkah. Wanga uAllah angayamkela iHajj yakho.

Isalathiso esibanzi seHajj kunye ne-Umrah: inkcazo kunye nezigwebo, iintlobo zezithethe, i-mawaqit, amasiko inyathelo ngenyathelo kunye nobulumko bawo kunye nento abanokuyithetha kwisikhululo ngasinye, izithintelo ze-ihram, kunye nezibongozo. Khetha icandelo onqwenela ukuliphonononga.
Amagama abo, iisunnah, kunye noko kufuneka umphulaphuli athethe
Imithetho yokuzila ukutya, izitshitshisi zayo kunye neesunnah
Ukususela ekutyeleleni abagulayo ukuya ekuhlanjweni, ukungcwatywa kunye novelwano
Isikhokelo esipheleleyo: inyathelo ngenyathelo, ubulumko babo, kunye nezibongozo
Amagama angamashumi alithoba anethoba aneentsingiselo zawo
Yintoni eyaphula ukuhlamba kunye nomthandazo, kwaye yintoni engakwenziyo
Ukukholelwa kuAllâh, iingelosi zaKhe, iincwadi, abathunywa, iMini yokuGqibela kunye nommiselo kaThixo
Iintsika ezintlanu okwakhelwe phezu kwazo inkolo
Imithandazo yokuzithandela eqinisekisiweyo ngaphambi nasemva kwaleyo isisinyanzelo
Umthandazo inyathelo ngenyathelo, ukusuka kwi-takbir ukuya kwi-taslim
Ukuqala nokuphela kwemithandazo emihlanu yemihla ngemihla
Iimeko zayo, i-nisab kunye neendidi ezisibhozo zabamkeli

Wathi uMprofeti: “UAllh unamagama angamashumi alithoba anesithoba, ikhulu elinye ngaphantsi kwelinye; nabani na owabalayo uya kungena eParadesi. Cofa naliphi na igama ukuze ufunde ingcaciso yalo epheleleyo, intsingiselo kunye nobungqina obuvela kwiQuran.
